item.title: He offered strangers $10 to tie his shoe. Then things got weird
item.description: A Minnesota man promised $10 to anyone able to find him and tie his shoe. That was the least strange thing to happen.

item.title: The trade war between the U.S. and Canada could affect key midterm elections
item.description: Canada is Maine's top trade partner. And the current trade war between the U.S. and Canada could affect key midterm races there as well as other states that rely heavily on trade with Canada.

item.title: Scope of devastation in Nepal continues to grow
item.description: The latest on the floods in Nepal, where authorities now say more than 4,000 are currently considered missing — a sharp rise from the previous figures.

item.title: Trump's plan for economic D-day for Iran has one big hole: China
item.description: The Trump administration says it's asking countries to voluntarily cut off business with Iran to squeeze its economy further. But the most critical country — China — already says it won't cooperate.

item.title: Postpartum mental health needs a village
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy trial has shed new light in the dark corners of postnatal maternal health. We talk with a psychiatrist about women's mental health issues following childbirth.

item.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. famine alert system that Trump shut down, then reopened
item.description: The highly regarded FEWS NET network run by the U.S. has stopped posting data on Afghanistan, Somalia and Yemen -- three countries where an abrupt curtailment of U.S. aid has increased the risk of famine. Durrie Bouscaren, correspondent. Marc Silver, editor. ATC on Friday (8/28) or Monday. Digital on Friday.

item.title: U.S. military gives combat rations a makeover
item.description: The changing nature of warfare has prompted the Army to develop lighter, smaller meals for troops to carry into combat. And the new rations had to fuel performance better... and taste better.

item.title: The oil deal with the U.S. could be a boost for Venezuela's authoritarian regime
item.description: A sweeping Venezuela oil deal touted by Trump remains short on details —and could take years to deliver, while helping keep the country's unpopular leader in power.

item.title: Egypt's beloved breakfast is a fava bean duo with ancient roots
item.description: Egypt's most popular breakfast staple is a modern classic that's also been around for millennia. We take a look at taamiya for our summer series on breakfast around the globe.

item.title: NPR's 2-year search for the truth about deaths from heat
item.description: An investigation from NPR and Boston University finds that heat kills thousands of Americans every year. But official numbers radically undercount heat deaths.
